name: timesfm25_zero_shot
sources_used: gift-eval/notebooks/timesfm2p5.ipynb (official GIFT-Eval notebook for the TimesFM-2.5 leaderboard row)

forecast_config.max_context: min(15360, patch-rounded max context length of the 1024-series chunk)
forecast_config.per_core_batch_size: notebook 128; here capped by a token budget (chunking only, does not change the numbers)

settings.multivariate: flattened to independent univariate series (the notebook's to_univariate=True)
settings.nan_handling: passed through as NaN; TimesFM_2p5.forecast strips leading NaNs and linearly interpolates the rest
settings.mean_forecast: the model's mean channel (quantile output index 0)
settings.all_nan_context: replaced with zeros (TimesFM_2p5.forecast raises on an all-NaN series); 649 of 371,330 univariate series
